entries.odia: ଧନ୍ୟ ସେ ପ୍ରଜାପତି, ବରକୁ କନ୍ୟା ଘଟାଘଟି
entries.title: A fitting pair
entries.literal_meaning: Blessed is that Prajapati: bride and groom suit each other.
entries.explanation: The headword here means suiting one another. The line praises a pairing through an invocation of Prajapati, whose precise referent is not explained here. Our reading attends to mutual fit rather than judging either person alone. Whether a particular use is sincere or ironic would depend on its setting.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏଠି ଘଟାଘଟିର ଅର୍ଥ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ମାନିବା ବା ଉପଯୋଗୀ ହେବା। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପ୍ରଜାପତିଙ୍କୁ ଧନ୍ୟ କହି ଯୋଡ଼ିର ମେଳକୁ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରେ; ପ୍ରଜାପତି କାହାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ ଏଠି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଜଣକୁ ଅଲଗା ବିଚାରିବା ବଦଳେ ପରସ୍ପରର ମେଳକୁ ଦେଖେ। କଥାଟି ସରଳ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କି ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ, ତାହା ପ୍ରୟୋଗର ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରିବ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading follows the source’s mutual-fit gloss without fixing the speaker’s tone.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପରସ୍ପରର ମେଳକୁ ଦେଖେ, ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ପାଠକ ଦୁଇ ଚରିତ୍ରର ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “କେଉଁ କଥାରେ ସେମାନେ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ମାନନ୍ତି?” / Readers discuss why two fictional characters make a fitting pair. This scene is invented, not a marriage custom or compatibility test.
entries.cultural_context: Adjective sense4 supplies the gloss; intervening dying/critical-moment senses do not apply. No marriage arrangement, mythic incident or independently verified compatibility is asserted.

entries.odia: ହାଡ଼ ଗଜଗଜ ବେତକୋଳି, ତା ଖାଇଲେ କି ପେଟ ପୁରି
entries.title: Will this fill the belly?
entries.literal_meaning: Cane berries full of bones—will eating them fill the belly?
entries.explanation: The question sets the berry’s apparent bulk against what it offers to eat. The dictionary describes a layer around the seed, which helps us read the bone image. Our editorial application asks whether something supplies enough usable substance for its purpose; it is not a nutritional verdict about the fruit.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ଫଳର ଆକାର ସହ ତାହାର ଖାଇବା ଅଂଶକୁ ତୁଳନା କରେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ମଞ୍ଜି ଉପରେ ଏକ ସ୍ତର ଥିବା କଥା ଅଛି; ସେଥିରୁ ହାଡ଼ର ଚିତ୍ରଟି ବୁଝିହୁଏ। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ପଚାରେ, କୌଣସି ଜିନିଷରେ କାମ ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ସାର ଅଛି କି। ଏହା ଫଳର ପୋଷଣ ବିଷୟରେ ରାୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our application asks about usable substance, not the fruit’s measured food value.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କାମରେ ଲାଗୁଥିବା ସାରକୁ ପଚାରେ, ଫଳର ଖାଦ୍ୟମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ପୁସ୍ତିକାରେ ଅନେକ ସଜାଯାଇଥିବା ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଥିଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ କାମଟି କରିବାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଅଳ୍ପ। ପାଠକମାନେ ଦରକାରୀ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଯୋଡ଼ିବାକୁ କହିଲେ। / Readers ask for practical steps in a booklet with many decorated pages but little guidance. This comparison is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The source calls it a cane berry and describes peel, seed and surrounding material. No botanical species, dietary advice or tested measure of nourishment is supplied.

entries.title: An insult and a plea
entries.literal_meaning: You call me a loose woman; do not go to live elsewhere.
entries.explanation: The reply places a plea not to leave beside a degrading name. Its position follows the dictionary’s pejorative sense, not its separate slender-body senses. Our critical reading keeps the speaker’s request distinct from accepting the insult. The source does not identify the relationship or explain why the speaker asks the other person not to leave.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅପମାନଜନକ ନାମର ପାଖରେ ଚାଲି ନ ଯିବାର ଅନୁରୋଧ ଆସିଛି। ଉତ୍ସରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ନାରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଅପମାନସୂଚକ ଅର୍ଥ ପରେ ଅଛି, ପତଳା ଦେହର ଅଲଗା ଅର୍ଥ ପରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ଅନୁରୋଧକୁ ଅପମାନ ମାନିନେବାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ। ସମ୍ପର୍କ କଣ ବା କାହିଁକି ଯିବାକୁ ମନା କରାଯାଉଛି, ଉତ୍ସ କହେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical response separates the request to stay from the insulting label.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ରହିବାର ଅନୁରୋଧକୁ ଅପମାନଜନକ ନାମଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “କାହାକୁ ରହିବାକୁ କହିବାରୁ ତାଙ୍କ ଅପମାନକୁ ସତ ବୋଲି ମାନିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ କି?” / A reader asks whether wanting someone to stay means accepting their insult. The discussion is invented, not a reconstructed domestic incident.
entries.cultural_context: Sense3 supplies a historically judgmental label. It is retained as attributed language, not an established trait, relationship history or traditional counter-moral.
